decision.explanation: The provided documents contain two conflicting assertions regarding Stefan Themerson's spouse. Document 1 (D1S8, D1S12, D1S16) explicitly states he was married to Franciszka Themerson from 1931 until their deaths in 1988. Document 2 (D2S2) presents a contradictory narrative claiming he recently married Julia Mercedes Grynyer. Per the instruction to 'Keep supported alternate referents rather than one familiar winner' and treat all sources as fallible without inventing authority to resolve the contradiction, both names are returned as valid answers derived from the respective source segments.
